# Announcement sequencing plan · [Announcement] · [Event] · [Date]

**Owner:** [PM with product marketing and communications]   **Embargo lift:** [Date, time, time zone]

| When | Audience | What they learn | Format | Under | Owner | Ready? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T−[n] weeks | Sales, support, partners | Full detail, readiness labels, FAQ, hard questions | Enablement session, FAQ | Internal confidentiality | | |
| T−[n] weeks | Analysts | Strategy, specifics, roadmap boundaries | Pre-brief | NDA | | |
| T−[n] days | Press | Release, briefing book, spokesperson access | Pre-brief | Embargo | | |
| T zero | Public | The announcement | Press release at embargo lift | | | |
| T zero | Event audience | The story and the demo | Keynote | | | |
| T zero to T+[n] days | Practitioners | Detail and hands-on | Breakouts, labs, webinar | | | |
| T+[n] weeks | Customers and partners | Fit for their accounts | Advisory boards, account reviews | | | |
| GA | Everyone | Availability | Release notes, blog, pricing page | | | |

## Embargo terms
- Embargo lifts at: [date, time, time zone]
- What is under embargo: [release, briefing book, demo video]
- What is never for publication: [internal numbers, unannounced pricing]
- What happens if it breaks: [communications owner's plan]

## Readiness gate for GA
GA is confirmed when: [criteria, such as eval thresholds, support readiness, security sign-off]. Not before.

## Leak plan
If the news leaks before lift: [who decides, what we say, which audiences we contact first]
